title: Salmão no mercado
grammar: Is there any…? e There is not any…
goal: Pergunte com Is there any…? e negue com There is not any….
reading: Lou looks for fish at the market.
The seller opens a big cold box.
O vendedor abre uma caixa fria e grande.
There is not any fresh salmon today.
But there is some fresh seafood.
Mas tem frutos do mar frescos.
dialogue: Yes, it is in the cold box.
There is not any salmon today.
Yes, there are some in the box.
pron: Comece com /fr/ e termine com /ʃ/: FRÉSH, sem vogal no fim.
